name: Thelsamar Blood Sausages
summary: In Thelsamar, Vidra Hearthstove keeps the town fed with blood sausages, a favorite across Loch Modan. She needs fresh ingredients from the valley to make them.

sections.title: A Hearty Highland Dish
sections.body: Hungry children and miners returning from the Ironband Excavation fill Thelsamar's tavern. Vidra Hearthstove tends the stove and makes the blood sausages known across Loch Modan. The recipe draws on wildlife from the rugged mountain pass.

sections.title: Unconventional Spices
sections.body: Vidra's recipe uses boar intestines for casings and bear meat for the filling. Spider ichor gives the sausages a sharp, pungent bite. Gathering the entrails and venomous fluid takes a steady stomach, but travelers soon come to appreciate the regional favorite.

faq.answer: Vidra Hearthstove cooks at the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar. She takes pride in feeding Loch Modan's hard-working folk, especially laborers from nearby excavation sites.

faq.q: Why does the recipe use spider ichor?
faq.answer: Vidra uses spider ichor to give her blood sausages a sharp, pungent flavor.
The sausages feed Thelsamar's townspeople, its children, and weary workers returning from shifts at the Ironband Excavation.
Black bears, mountain boars, and wood lurker spiders roam the wilderness and wooded hills around the lake in Loch Modan.

faq.q: What casing is used for the sausages?
faq.answer: Vidra uses casings cleaned from local mountain boars to hold the bear meat and seasoned filling together over the fire.

faq.q: Do travelers learn to cook these sausages?
faq.answer: Yes. Bring Vidra the ingredients, and she shares her recipe so travelers with cooking skills can make the sausages themselves.

angles.text: Gather ingredients for Vidra and aspiring cooks can learn the Blood Sausage recipe, adding hearty field rations to their cooking.
As a dwarf, blood sausage is a familiar comfort food, shaped by the rugged tastes of Khaz Modan's mountain clans.
As an Alliance member, you can help keep Thelsamar's workforce fed as they maintain key infrastructure and excavate ancient ruins across Loch Modan.
